title: potentilla glandulosa var. wrangelliana
intro: Potentilla glandulosa var. wrangelliana, commonly known as Wrangell's cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species within the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Wrangell's cinquefoil include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Wrangell's cinquefoil, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions and overall health benefits.
